article.title: 그래도
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The Korean Basic Dictionary records **그래도** as a contraction of 그리하여도/그러하여도 and gives examples where a prior circumstance is acknowledged but the following decision or judgment remains. This entry is limited to those attested concessive examples.
